decision.ruling: pin the census ticket-owned path list literally
decision.reason: every remaining product ticket then needs a census edit, and the deletion it was meant to catch is already caught by the focused-lane count guard
pathlib is the only current storage shape and replay does not need another

decision.ruling: filtering the roadmap and Board out of a broad input scan
decision.reason: an exclusion list silently readmits any projection added later, so the input set is declared positively and closed

decision.ruling: adding coverage gates or a badge
decision.reason: one workflow that tells the truth is worth more than five nobody reads
a literal detached from the producer methods can silently accept evidence no collector emits
canonical artifact bytes already preserve the replay contract without duplicating serializers

decision.ruling: embed the canonical reports in specs/doctor-output.v0.json
decision.reason: the ticket grants fixtures/doctor/*.json, and sibling precedent does not override a path the ticket names
half of them are permissions errors and no amount of waiting fixes those

decision.ruling: add the two paths to controlPlaneAllowlist
decision.reason: mislabels product code as control plane and drives control_plane_code_files up as a disguise for a growing product surface

decision.ruling: keep the lane counts as a floor
decision.reason: two cases of slack let whole test cases and five allowlists be removed without a failure

decision.ruling: letting a grading failure end the run
decision.reason: it makes one flaky model call discard every candidate already screened

decision.ruling: keep the wildcard census and rely on the focused-lane guard
decision.reason: the guard catches deletion only, and the review demonstrated growth passing 230/230 with an unreviewed product file present
each of the 60 remaining tickets would need a coordinated census amendment, and the list drifts from the tickets it mirrors

decision.ruling: pin every prose field by literal digest
decision.reason: freezing the full text duplicates the contract into the validator and makes any editorial fix a false failure, so only fields the contract derives or fixes numerically are pinned
replay must recompute output from recorded port responses
both are pure deterministic domain functions with no outside capability to supply
SQLite keeps each artifact atomically constrained with its correction lineage
